## Summary
A brief description of the feature.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this solve? What gap does it fill in the current workflow?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you'd like it to work.

## Alternatives Considered
Other approaches you considered and why you chose this one.

## Scope Check
- [ ] This feature is **purely defensive** (analysis, detection, reporting)
- [ ] This feature does NOT execute samples or modify files
- [ ] This feature does NOT introduce network capabilities beyond hash-based OSINT lookups

## Additional Context
Any mockups, references, or related tools.
